Turkish Get-Up
Full Body
Kettlebell

STAND 6/6

Replay
Slower
PRIMARY
Shoulders, Core
SECONDARY
Triceps, Upper Back, Glutes, Quads

Instructions

Preparation: Lie on your back with the bell beside your shoulder. Press it up with both hands to a locked arm, then free one hand.

1

Press the bell up; eyes on it.

2

Roll onto your free elbow, arm locked.

3

Push up onto your free hand.

4

Lift your hips high off the floor.

5

Sweep your leg back into a half-kneel.

6

Stand tall, then reverse each step down.

Watch out

Eyes lock on the bell from start to finish. If you lose sight of it or the arm bends, stop the set — a falling bell on a shoulder ends seasons.
